scope: Base Fantasy scores only; no banner quality, banner traits, or coach-title bonuses.

deaths.label: Deaths
deaths.note: Score is floored at zero; values greater than 10 also score zero.

madstones.label: Madstones collected
madstones.note: item_uses.madstone_bundle is only a low-reliability candidate and is not scored.

roshan_kills.label: Roshan kills
roshan_kills.note: Use roshans_killed, not the conflicting roshan_kills field.

teamfight_participation.label: Teamfight participation
teamfight_participation.note: OpenDota supplies a ratio in the inclusive range 0..1.

stun_duration.label: Stun duration
stun_duration.note: Negative parser anomalies are quarantined as unavailable, never clamped to zero.

tormentor_kills.label: Tormentor kills
tormentor_kills.note: Match totals cross-check, but individual attribution is medium reliability.
